title: Sebastian and the Drop
author: Sebastian Halloran
blurb: Orsen Lockridge, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
